title: •Unexpected Interruption
caption: •Unexpected Interruption (V)
game_text: If a battle was just initiated, target an opponent’s female non-droid character present with Xizor. Draw destiny. Target excluded from battle and adds her power to Xizor’s for remainder of turn if destiny +2 > target’s ability.
lore: “Sir! Sir! I’ve isolated the reverse power flux coupling!”
